# formatted-text / config

The **formatted-text** type's config capability: the `formattedTextField`
factory (core — a `FieldDef<string>` with `rows`, schema `z.string()`: any
source is valid) and the renderer contributed to `config-v2.fields.renderer`
(web): a monospace textarea (debounced autosave, flushed on blur, like
`multiline-text`'s; `rows` defaults to 4), the syntax in one caption line,
and the draft as it will read, drawn by the parent's `FormattedTextView`.
The syntax: [`../../CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md).
